correctness.rationale: Independently re-verified all essential computations. Rebuilt enum.c with gcc -O2 and re-ran full n=8..11 closures for 2413 and 1324: byte-identical counts, qhist and anomalies=0 to committed JSON. Wrote independent Python brute-force enumerator (itertools + combinations avoidance + O(n^2) interval classifier + min-block inflation search): all 7 classes at n=8 match committed (total, simple, sum, skew, inflation, qhist) exactly. Ran committed crosscheck.py backtrack for 2413/n=9 and 1324/n=9: AGREE including qhist. Ran crosscheck.py samples for all 7 x n=10,11: SAMPLES-OK x14 (55 checks each). Independently verified 3 headline witnesses (1234: 2 6 11 1 10 5 9 4 8 3 7; 2413: 7 1 3 8 4 9 5 10 6 11 2; 1324: 2 4 6 8 10 1 11 9 7 5 3) avoid claimed pattern and are interval-free. Verified row sums (simple+sum+skew+inflation=total) and qhist sums (=inflation) in all 28 cells; 2413 sum=skew exactly at all n; totals partition into 3 Wilf groups ({1234,1243,1432,2143}=15767/94359/586590/3763290, {1342,2413}=15485/91245/555662/3475090, {1324}=15793/94776/591950/3824112) consistent with known 3 Wilf classes; Av(1324) totals match OEIS A061552 fetched live. Verified 7 claimed reps are a full transversal of the 24 patterns under reverse/complement/inverse (own orbit enumeration: 7 orbits of sizes 2,4,2,8,4,2,2, each containing exactly one rep). Audited code: left-to-right backtracking prunes exactly occurrences ending at new value (complete: any occurrence avoiding prefix would have been pruned earlier); interval/simple/sum/skew tests implement standard definitions; sum and skew categories proved disjoint (exhaustive S8 check found no overlap; general prefix argument), so priority order is immaterial; inflation min-block search over 2^(n-1)-1 masks with explicit simple-quotient check (anomalies=0). Evidence is computational (exhaustive enumeration), not closed-form proof; n=10,11 full tables rest on Script A plus quota-sample/witness re-verification, honestly disclosed in DRAFT section 7. This is experimental certification, sufficient for an exact census claim at this scale.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison to nearest priors, not timestamp/failed-search. (1) Brignall 0801.0963 (survey of simple permutations, fetched): establishes substitution/simple theory and finite-vs-infinite-simples properties but records no per-class simple/sum/skew/inflation counts for single length-4 principals and no extremal witness. (2) Bagno et al. 2303.13115 (fetched): blockwise-simple forbids p1(+/-)p2 intervals with generating function/recursion/interval-poset bijection — different object and statistic, no partition of Av_n(pi) for length-4 principals. (3) Gao-Kitaev-Zhang 1605.05490 (fetched): complete classification of sum-indecomposable (no proper prefix which is a permutation) permutations avoiding length-3/4 patterns plus recursion for 12...k-avoiding indecomposables — covers only the sum-decomposable axis, not simple counts, skew counts, inflation quotient-length histograms, or extremal simple-rich vs simple-poor ranking; even where sum counts overlap, the simple/qhist/extremal data are not implied. (4) OEIS A061552 (fetched live): bare 1324-avoiding totals (15793/94776/591950/3824112 confirm totals) with growth literature, no substitution-type breakdown or witnesses. (5) OEIS A111111 (fetched live): global simple-permutation totals (0,2,6,46,338,2926,...) and Albert-Atkinson links, no per-principal-class refinement. No source tables simple/sum/skew/inflation census across the 7 single length-4 principals to n=8..11, quotient profiles, or the 1234>...>2413 extremal ranking. Claim is materially distinct from blocked pair-set/insertion-encoding attempts (different objects, method, witnesses).

value.rationale: Strongest headline is self-contained and independently retrievable under the exact-invariant clause: complete substitution-type census (simple/sum/skew/inflation + simple-quotient histogram) for the closed natural unit of all 7 dihedral classes x consecutive n=8..11, with identical simple-count ranking 1234>1243>1432>1324>2143>1342>2413 at every n, n=11 extremes 278611 (7.40%) vs 4830 (0.14%, ~57.7x, margin 273781; max/runner-up margin 168395), and explicit interval-free witnesses. Object and invariant were motivated before computation (Albert-Atkinson/Vatter simple-skeleton dichotomy calibrating algebraic vs non-D-finite enumeration, Brignall survey). Values were not known (databases hold only bare totals/global simples) and are not mechanically implied by theory. A future researcher studying simple-richness, substitution closure, or extremal principal classes could reasonably need these precise counts, densities, qhist profiles, and witnesses. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained number: table carries interpretation (simple-rich 1234 vs simple-poor 2413 with symmetry certificate sum=skew) and certified witnesses. Full n=11 target delivered, so no incomplete-census discount applies.

Quotient-simplicity for inflations at n=10,11 relies on Script A anomalies=0 counter re-executed from source; independent Python re-verification covered quotient lengths (best-block counts) on samples but did not separately re-assert simplicity of every quotient — theory (unique substitution decomposition) plus anomalies=0 covers it
Evidence is computational exhaustion, not a human-readable proof or closed form; future reuse should cite the replay procedure and versioned artifacts
